column2: Explicitly branded "THIS IS NOT WHISKEY" -- a non-alcoholic (<0.3% ABV) dealcoholized whiskey-flavored beverage made by UNDONE GmbH (Germany) via a patented dealcoholization process; it contains no whisky at all.

Legally a "Spirit Drink", not Scotch Whisky: 35% ABV (below the 40% Scotch minimum), made with added Brazilian lime peel, vanilla essence and sugar. Produced by George Ballantine & Son Ltd/Pernod Ricard from a Scotch whisky base, but the finished product itself does not qualify as whisky under Scotch Whisky Regulations.
